description: This file defines the TransportServer class, which implements a low-level network server for Spark, handling network connections, server bootstrap setup, and resource management.

classes.name: TransportServer
classes.description: A network server class for Spark that manages network connections, server bootstrap, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: TransportServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and binds the server to a specified host and port.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the server bootstrap, event loops, and binds to the network address.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Returns the set of metrics associated with the server.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the server and releases resources.

methods.name: getRegisteredConnections
methods.description: Returns the counter of registered connections.
